The pieces someone saved with the heart, each in the finish they liked. The finish can change
here, and each card says whether that finish is in stock. A sold-out one links to the piece, where
people can ask to be told when it's back. Everything in stock goes into the cart with one button,
and the list can be shared as a link.

<Template name="wishlist" />

## Try it

- Save a few pieces with the heart on the [collection](/templates/collection/), then come back.
- Change a saved piece's finish; the stock and the picture follow.
- **Copy a link to this list**, and open it in another tab: it shows that list, to look at or
  keep.

## Details that matter

- **Saved pieces live in the browser,** like the cart, and the count in the header follows them
  in every tab.
- **Removing one can be undone**, and focus moves to the next card instead of getting lost.
- **"Add all" says how many are in stock** when some aren't, so nothing is skipped quietly.
